title: Tech Lab
description: Your homelab devices, services, and observed health.

overview.title: Your homelab
overview.collector: Enabled monitors run in the background while the monolith API is running, even after you close the browser. They resume after an API restart. Visiting Tech Lab or saving an enabled monitor also registers checks.

devices.empty: No devices yet. Add your first server, computer, NAS, or network device.
devices.glancesHelp: Use an HTTP or HTTPS Glances API URL without embedded credentials. Leave it blank to disable telemetry.
devices.noServices: No services are linked to this device.

services.empty: No services yet. Add a hosted app, game server, or link.

health.title: Observed monitor health
health.monitorHelp: Checks measure reachability, not authenticated application health. HTTP 401 and 403 count as reachable endpoints requiring authorization. Only explicitly enabled monitors are contacted.
health.observedHelp: This ratio is based on observed checks for the current monitor configuration, including errors. It is not continuous uptime. No samples means unknown.
health.historyHelp: Failed and errored checks leave gaps in the latency chart. History retains earlier monitor targets and revisions.
health.noChecks: No checks recorded in this range.
health.truncated: This range exceeds the history result limit. A bounded subset is shown.

settings.title: Refresh & retention settings
settings.help: Page refresh is separate from each monitor’s check interval. Staleness is measured in missed monitor intervals. Retention controls stored checks.

messages.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Keep editing or discard them to leave.
messages.newerVersion: This entry changed elsewhere. Your draft is retained; a stale save will be rejected. Cancel and reopen to load the latest version.
messages.deleteDevice: Delete “{{name}}”? Its services will stay in the inventory without a device assignment.
messages.deleteService: Delete “{{name}}”? Stored check snapshots are retained by the server.
messages.notFound: This entry is unavailable in your inventory.
messages.emptyInventory: Build your inventory by adding services or reviewing a Homepage import.
messages.failureHelp: The operation failed. Existing inventory and editor drafts remain available. Retry or reopen the latest entry before saving again.

import.title: Review an inventory import
import.help: Upload or paste a native JSON inventory or Homepage services/bookmarks file. Preview before applying. Imports merge entries; existing entries are skipped. Source credentials and unsupported widgets are not imported.
import.tooLarge: The source must be 1 MiB or smaller.
import.readFailed: The file could not be read. Choose it again or paste its text.
import.monitorsDisabled: All imported monitors are disabled. Review each target and enable monitoring explicitly after import.
import.skipped: Skipped {{devices}} existing devices and {{services}} existing services / links.
import.exportHelp: Download your devices, services, monitor configuration and settings as JSON. Check history and credentials are excluded. Import merges inventory with monitoring disabled; it does not restore settings or check history.
